findings.description: The new gzip-path check constructed URL directly and could throw before the audited fetch guard handled invalid input.
findings.failure_scenario: A malformed sitemap URL reaches fetchXml, which throws synchronously instead of returning null without making a request.

findings.description: A gzip expansion beyond the output cap was initially classified as a malformed body instead of a bounded response.
findings.failure_scenario: A small compressed sitemap expands beyond 5 MiB, producing misleading malformed telemetry and omitting the truncated marker.
